penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Salesforce OmniScript/Experience Cloud debugging requires hands-on investigation of each customer's org configuration, permissions, and data model — per-customer manual work is unavoidable for a proper fix or diagnosis.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise Salesforce customers expect back-and-forth clarification and follow-up on complex platform bugs — automated support alone is insufficient for this ICP.

rationale: Salesforce developers and admins at enterprises are excellent buyers — they have budget, pay for tooling, and their orgs are already spending heavily on Salesforce licenses. The problem, however, is that a real solution requires per-customer org access and manual debugging of permissions, data models, and OmniScript configurations — there is no way to automate this meaningfully with Claude alone. A generic diagnostic guide or checklist can be built easily, but it would not command enterprise pricing and could not be sold as a recurring service. The mandatory per-customer human work tanks both the autonomy score and the penalty-adjusted total. Drop unless a narrow self-serve diagnostic tool (no org access needed, just a structured questionnaire) can be validated.
solution_plan: As a full consulting or managed-fix service this is not viable for a solo non-technical operator — each case requires Salesforce org access and platform expertise. A narrower self-serve product might work: a 'Salesforce OmniScript Guest User Diagnostic Checklist' — a structured intake form that walks the developer through the 8-10 known root causes (sharing rules, guest profile permissions, ContentVersion visibility settings), Claude generates a prioritized fix list, and they get a PDF. Build: a detailed Claude prompt trained on Salesforce docs + a form + automated email delivery + Stripe at ~$29. Sell: target Salesforce Stack Exchange and Salesforce developer forums with a free version of the checklist; paid version gives a detailed, org-specific action plan. Maintain: fully automated once built. Honest caveat: the market for a $29 PDF checklist in this niche is probably very small (dozens, not thousands of buyers), so validate demand before building.
notes: operational_autonomy (5) fails the 7-floor build_gate. Total after penalties (3.7) falls well below min_total_to_validate. The per-customer manual fulfillment is the decisive disqualifier.
